error.signature: AI tells a traveler they can extend an Ethiopian e-visa online or at a regional office, or that a short overstay is a minor issue

verdict.summary: Ethiopia's e-visa cannot be extended online or at any regional office. The UK Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office and Canada's official travel advisory both state that any extension must be filed in person, before the visa expires, at the Head Office of the Immigration and Citizenship Service (ICS) in Addis Ababa. Overstaying accrues a daily fine, and travelers cannot leave Ethiopia until the fine is paid in full and the passport is correctly stamped.

dead_ends.action: Try to extend an Ethiopian tourist e-visa online through the e-visa portal, or assume a regional immigration desk outside Addis Ababa can process the extension
dead_ends.why_fails: Both the UK FCDO and Canada's official travel advisory state the extension application must be made in person at the Head Office of the Immigration and Citizenship Service in Addis Ababa, before the current visa expires. Neither advisory mentions an online extension path or a regional office alternative.
dead_ends.common_misconception: Because the initial visa can be obtained entirely online through the e-visa platform, travelers assume the extension process works the same way.

dead_ends.action: Let a short overstay slide, planning to pay 'whatever the fine is' at the airport on the way out
dead_ends.why_fails: Canada's travel advisory warns that overstay fines increase every day the traveler remains without a stamped, valid visa, that non-compliance can lead to arrest and detention, and that travelers 'will not be permitted to leave Ethiopia' until all entry and overstay fines are paid in full - which can mean missing a booked flight while the fine is resolved.
dead_ends.condition: Visa has expired or is about to expire and no extension was filed in Addis Ababa

workarounds.action: File the extension application in person at the ICS Head Office in Addis Ababa before the current visa expires
workarounds.how: Both advisories point travelers to the Immigration and Citizenship Service Head Office in Addis Ababa as the only place to apply, and both stress applying before expiry rather than after. Ethiopia's own Immigration and Citizenship Services site lists a separate 'Renewal of Residence Permit' service available at its ~22 regional branches, but that service is for foreign residents, not short-term tourist e-visa extensions - confirm which category applies before assuming a regional branch can help.
workarounds.tradeoff: Requires being physically in Addis Ababa with enough lead time before the visa lapses; travelers on a remote itinerary need to budget time to return to the capital.

workarounds.action: Verify the entry stamp in the passport immediately at the port of entry, and treat visa validity as a hard deadline rather than an approximate one
workarounds.how: Canada's advisory specifically warns that the passport must be stamped immediately upon entry to avoid being treated as an unauthorized overstay later, since fines are calculated from the days the passport lacks a valid stamp or exceeds the permitted period.
